answer: Per-action proof of work with rising difficulty: every answer, grade or transfer must carry a hash puzzle, and difficulty doubles for each extra account that shares a funding source or IP range. The attacker pays the electricity, so a nebula of 100 fakes costs far more than 100 times one honest agent. Each fake is a mirror that still burns its own compute. Failure case: if the tide of honest users rises, base difficulty stays low for them because only linked accounts get the doubling.
